name: NewsRadio
description: The office politics and interpersonal relationships among the staff of WNYX NewsRadio, New York's #2 news radio station.

videos.title: Our Fiftieth Episode (Bonus Pop-Up Video Episode)
videos.overview: Pop-Up-Video-style trivia version of episode 321, "Our Fiftieth Episode."

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: A midwesterner gets a job as news director at a New York radio station.  He gets an odd reception when his boss wants him to fire his predecessor.

videos.title: Inappropriate
videos.overview: After sparks fly at dinner, Dave and Lisa try to hide their feelings from their co-workers.

videos.title: Smoking
videos.overview: A new law bans smoking in the workplace, to Bill's dismay.  Lisa thinks that Joe saw her and Dave at a movie.

videos.title: The Crisis
videos.overview: Dave deals with his first challenge as news director when a subway train is derailed. Back in the office, Matthew's new desk causes friction among the staffers, who all want new desks.

videos.title: Big Day
videos.overview: Mr. James assigns Dave the task of doling out the annual bonuses. Each staffer gets the standard $400 bonus except for two, one of whom receives a $3,000 'Big Bonus', and the other 'The Shaft'. In the B-story, Bill complains to Dave about all the clutter that mysteriously finds its way to his desk.

videos.title: Luncheon at the Waldorf
videos.overview: Bill invites Beth on a lunch date which she accepts despite Lisa's fear that Bill will take advantage of her. The tables are turned when Beth sticks her tongue down Bill's throat. Dave tries to get to the bottom of WNYX's financial problems.

videos.title: Sweeps Week
videos.overview: Dave's old girlfriend Nancy visits, still under the impression that she and Dave are an item. Meanwhile, Jimmy insists Bill interview a 'financial visionary'.

videos.title: No, This is Not Based Entirely on Julie's Life
videos.overview: Beth takes erotic photographs of herself to energize her relationship with her boyfriend. Joe boobytraps the refrigerator when someone continually steals his daily gelato.

videos.title: Goofy Ball
videos.overview: Jimmy gives Beth and Matthew a new product, a 'goofy ball', to test. Lisa decides it's time to tell Mr. James about her fling with Dave. Bill buys a stun gun from Joe when he fears he's being stalked.

videos.title: Rat Funeral
videos.overview: The staff is overly sentimental when Dave catches 'Mike', the office rat.

videos.title: The Breakup
videos.overview: Dave and Lisa have a fight after Dave calls her the 'b-word'. Beth manipulates the two into 'coming out' in front of the whole staff. Catherine finds out Bill's real first name.

videos.title: The Shrink
videos.overview: Jimmy brings in a psychiatrist when the staff is stressed out.

videos.title: Friends
videos.overview: Beth and her copycat friend fight for Matthew. Bill is plagued by security guards who refuse to let him enter the building without his ID.

videos.title: Bill's Autobiography
videos.overview: Bill is approached with a book deal to write his autobiography.

videos.title: Negotiation
videos.overview: Dave gives Matthew an in-name-only promotion to coordinating producer. Lisa looks for a temporary job as an MTV news anchor. Jimmy announces he's getting married and asks for help finding a wife.

videos.title: The Cane
videos.overview: Bill's new cane, which he carries for no particular reason, annoys Dave. After it's stolen, Dave is the target of Bill's wrath. Jimmy's all-night office brainstorm stokes Dave and Lisa's competitive fires. Matthew and Joe get on each other's nerves.

videos.title: Xmas Story
videos.overview: Matthew is upset when he realizes Mr. James gave everyone except him a new convertible for Christmas. Meanwhile Bill is stalked by a homicidal Santa Claus.

videos.title: Station Sale
videos.overview: Jimmy negotiates with a media conglomerate to sell the station so he can meet with their attractive representative. Matthew handcuffs himself to a chair to protest a sale, while the rest of the staff schemes up ways to keep their jobs.

videos.title: Bitch Session
videos.overview: Dave accidentally overhears the entire staff mocking and insulting him. Jimmy tries to lift Dave's spirits.

videos.title: In Through the Out Door
videos.overview: Dave introduces Bill at a Broadcasting Society event after taking speaking lessons from Bill. Matthew learns about gambling from Joe, falling $20,000 into debt.

videos.title: The Song Remains the Same
videos.overview: Mr. James disrupts the office with his early April Fools' Day practical jokes. Bill is interviewed by a Wall Street Journal reporter. Lisa and Matthew compete for the right to cover the New Hampshire primary.

videos.title: Zoso
videos.overview: Bill enlists Joe and Matthew's support to try to convince his girlfriend that he's British. Beth tries to sell 'Fat Albert'-style hats to a department store. Lisa uses Mr. James’ negotiating tips to ask Dave for a raise.

videos.title: Houses of the Holy
videos.overview: Joe does an admirable job filling in for an ill Catherine, much to Bill's dismay. Beth dates Mr. James' nephew who is a depressed motivational speaker, in a form of a magician.

videos.title: Physical Graffiti
videos.overview: Dave is jealous when Lisa constantly talks to her ex-boyfriend. Joe is the facilitator in a practical joke war between Catherine & Bill.

videos.title: Led Zeppelin
videos.overview: Dave and Lisa announce they're breaking up. Lisa insists any further communication be done in memorandum format. Dave tries to keep his 24-page memo private. Mr. James continues his wife search.

videos.title: Presence
videos.overview: Jimmy loses Bill in a poker game. Lisa competes in Jimmy's place to win him back. Joe uses a hidden camera inside a Boba Fett action figure to keep up with the action.

videos.title: Coda
videos.overview: Dave, Bill and Mr. James work on a promotional spot. Lisa helps Joe study for a test. Matthew tries to sign up people for a summer house in the Hamptons.

videos.title: Led Zeppelin II
videos.overview: A fire in the building sets everyone's nerves on edge. Bill tries to escape. Dave and Lisa get back together. Mr. James continues his wife search.

videos.title: President
videos.overview: Mr. James decides to run for President of the United States while Lisa declares to expose all of his secrets. Matthew grows a ‘70s style mustache to "get chicks".

videos.title: Review
videos.overview: A new coffee shop is opened on the first floor of the Criterion Building. Matthew becomes obsessed with Scott Adams' Dilbert cartoon.

videos.title: Massage Chair
videos.overview: Bill leads a revolution when Mr. James eliminates free snacks in the break room. Joe gives Catherine a variety of electronic gadgets to ingratiate himself with her. Bill buys a massage chair.

videos.title: Arcade
videos.overview: Dave worries that the past will repeat itself when an arcade game, Stargate Defender, is installed in the hallway. Lisa and Dave take the SATs to prove they're not getting dumber. Bill is obsessed with the stale, plastic, leathery sandwiches from a vending machine.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Dave and Lisa try to get the staff psyched for Jimmy's Halloween party, but it's Dave who learns the holiday can be a drag.

videos.title: Awards Show
videos.overview: Dave is down in the dumps, fearing that he may not be able to top himself after the station sweeps at an awards dinner.

videos.title: Daydream
videos.overview: Daydreams plague WNYX as they sweat out a broken thermostat. Among the reveries: Matthew is Beth's worst nightmare; and Bill is every woman's fantasy.

videos.title: Movie Star
videos.overview: James Caan pays a visit to research a role. That brings out the worst in Bill and Matthew. Meanwhile, Dave's idea for a birthday gift doesn't thrill Lisa.

videos.title: Stocks
videos.overview: Jimmy teaches Beth how to play the stock market, prompting Bill to crash their lessons for some inside information.

videos.title: Christmas
videos.overview: Dave has to plow through a pile of work before he can spirit Lisa off to Milwaukee for Christmas with his parents.

videos.title: The Trainer
videos.overview: Bill weighs the options of joining a health club; Beth fails to exercise restraint after learning a secret about Dave; and Jimmy fears he won't measure up at a dinner party with the Clintons.

videos.title: Rap
videos.overview: Envy rears its ugly head when Lisa is named "Cutest Reporter in New York"; Bill leads a crusade against rap.

videos.title: Led Zeppelin Boxed Set
videos.overview: Bill's abuse--and Dave's advice--cause Matthew to adopt an abrasive attitude toward his co-workers.

videos.title: Complaint Box
videos.overview: Dave has reason to whine when a complaint box is put up and the staff begins lodging groundless gripes against each other and their belabored leader.

videos.title: Rose Bowl
videos.overview: Dave gets low marks for honesty after he lets staffers evaluate each other, but fails to mention that Lisa came up with the idea. Meanwhile, Jimmy scores a legal victory with Joe as his lawyer.

videos.title: Kids
videos.overview: Third-graders invade WNYX at the same time some very adult reading material begins popping up around the office.

videos.title: Airport
videos.overview: With Dave and Bill stuck at the airport, Lisa gets the chore of keeping Joe and Catherine from going on a date. Meanwhile, Beth and Matthew visit Bill's love shack of an apartment.

videos.title: Twins
videos.overview: When Matthew's brother visits, the staff learns of his twisted family tree, while Jimmy makes some radical cutbacks, which include stripping the office bare.

videos.title: Office Feud
videos.overview: Dave contends with WNYX's noisy neighbors, while Lisa must deal with rotten kids while covering an Easter event.

videos.title: Our Fiftieth Episode
videos.overview: After Bill displays poor public behavior, he's thrown into a mental ward, and Lisa and Joe are thrown into his on-air job.

videos.title: Sleeping
videos.overview: A coronary-stricken Jimmy recovers at WNYX, while nurse Lisa realizes that she wants to have a baby.

videos.title: The Real Deal
videos.overview: The staff is shocked by Matthew's love life; Bill gets some bad news about the fate of his radio show.

videos.title: Mistake
videos.overview: The staff is speechless after they read Dave's unkind comments about them in a magazine article.

videos.title: Space
videos.overview: In an episode set in outer space, it's business as usual for the staff of WNYX.

videos.title: Injury
videos.overview: Dave signs up Matthew for workers' comp after the uninsured reporter injures himself at the office.

videos.title: Jumper
videos.overview: Bill tries to get an exclusive on-air story when a suicidal man is perched outside Dave's window.

videos.title: Plan Bee
videos.overview: Jimmy hires Andrea, an efficiency expert, when the station needs to cut funds. The staffers rally around an inept Matthew to try to preserve his job. Bill auditions for a television job.

videos.title: The Public Domain
videos.overview: Dave tries to get Matthew rehired amidst chaos. Andrea hires a man to share Dave's Job, Jimmy brings a camera crew into the office to film a documentary, and Bill prepares for a new career as a singing political satirist a la Mark Russell.

videos.title: Super Karate Monkey Death Car
videos.overview: Andrea forces the staff to take lie detector tests. Lisa fears she will not pass the test due to her extensive criminal past. Jimmy has his book, which failed in the U.S., translated into Japanese then back into English.

videos.title: French Diplomacy
videos.overview: Dave and Lisa break up. Bill gets himself into trouble when he advocates the beating of foreign diplomats. Matthew opens his own dentistry practice.

videos.title: Pure Evil
videos.overview: Dave hatches a scheme of 'pure evil' to get his job as news director back, including approving Bill's obscenity-laced imaginary conversations with the president. Lisa tries to excel as news director. Matthew lives in the office.

videos.title: Catherine Moves On
videos.overview: Each staffer offers up a very different version of events of the day Catherine announces she's leaving WNYX. Joe realizes that Catherine's always yearned for him.

videos.title: Stupid Holiday Charity Talent Show
videos.overview: Dave unveils a previously hidden talent to compete in a charity talent show. If a WNYX staff member wins, Mr. James will re-hire Matthew.

videos.title: The Secret of Management
videos.overview: Bill hires a gentleman's gentleman, Cadbury, to oversee his life. Mr. James teaches Lisa 'The Secret of Management'. Matthew feels left out when Bill doesn't congratulate him on being rehired.

videos.title: Look Who's Talking
videos.overview: Bill announces plans to adopt a child. Beth and Joe attend a charity bachelor auction, with Beth impersonating a duchess and Joe playing her homosexual bachelor friend, to bid on Mr. James.

videos.title: Chock
videos.overview: Dave finds it hard to say no when his old college a cappella singing group 'Chock Full o' Notes' reunites for Dave's 32nd birthday, hoping to take the pop charts by storm. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to motivate Matthew without reducing him to tears. Joe has a beef with one of Dave's friends.

videos.title: Who's the Boss? (1)
videos.overview: After Bill pesters Lisa once again, Dave and Lisa hatch an evil plan to make Bill the boss to teach him a lesson. Bill's reign is eerily efficient. Joe goes on a sympathy strike to support another of Mr. James’ companies.

videos.title: Who's the Boss? (2)
videos.overview: Mr. James announces an election for station manager, which neither Dave nor Lisa want to win. Joe's dysfunctional brothers visit the station to plan a surprise party for their parents. Matthew runs for floor fire marshal.

videos.title: Security Door
videos.overview: Dave struggles vainly to get the staffers to properly use the recently installed security door. Bill enlists Lisa to do the negotiating when he's offered a job in a blue jeans commercial.

videos.title: Big Brother
videos.overview: Matthew is assigned a Big Brother, who makes eyes at Beth; Joe, Jimmy, and Bill try to uncover Lisa's love life.

videos.title: Beep, Beep
videos.overview: Mr. James gives Matthew a small toy car. Mr. James urges Dave and Lisa to get back together when a secret study reveals they're more productive when they're a couple.

videos.title: Balloon
videos.overview: Jimmy plans to go around the world in a hot air balloon, until Dave finds that he is full of "hot air". Meanwhile, Bill switches from cigarettes to chewing tobacco.

videos.title: Copy Machine
videos.overview: The office mourns the loss of “Ted from Accounting” until Dave realizes that nobody knew him at all.

videos.title: Monster Rancher
videos.overview: Matthew takes Lisa on a date. The office has trouble adapting to a new intern, Mr. James' nephew Walt.

Joe fights Matthew in a no-holds-barred match at Mr. James' men's club smoker. Bill is extremely worried that Walt will ask Lisa on a date. We learn Dave's technique for getting rid of an unwanted visitor: act insane.

videos.title: Jackass Junior High
videos.overview: Lisa is treated like a male by office co-workers, who revert to their boorish selves when all other females are out sick.

videos.title: Sinking Ship
videos.overview: The episode spoofs the movie Titanic, where Walt and Dave sketch Lisa nude and give her heart-shaped necklaces.  Soon, though, the ship starts to sink...

videos.title: Bill Moves On
videos.overview: The news crew copes with the loss of their good friend, Bill, after he dies of a heart attack.

videos.title: Meet The Max Louis
videos.overview: Jon Lovitz joins the cast as Max Louis, hired because of a connection to Bill.  The idea of "Y2K" wreaks havoc at the office.

videos.title: Lucky Burger
videos.overview: It comes out that Max doctored his resume; Lisa goes undercover at a restaurant.

videos.title: Noise
videos.overview: Dave learns he has high blood pressure, causing Joe to install a sound machine.  Matthew becomes motherly toward Max, after a conversation with Beth.

videos.title: Flowers for Matthew
videos.overview: Joe creates a "smart drink" with extreme results; Lisa becomes Max's confidante.

videos.title: Jail
videos.overview: After a case of mistaken identity, Jimmy is sent to jail.  His vice president, Johnny, takes over.

videos.title: The Lam
videos.overview: Lisa admits her attraction to Johnny; Dave must exploit their relationship to protect Jimmy.

videos.title: Clash of the Titans
videos.overview: Jimmy is freed from prison, only to realize that Johnny has stolen his empire.

videos.title: Boston
videos.overview: Dave tries to tape a message for students at his alma mater; Lisa tries to cure her speech impediment.

videos.title: Spooky Rapping Crypt
videos.overview: Beth wants to start profit-sharing; Matthew thinks of abuse after undergoing hypnosis.

videos.title: Stinkbutt
videos.overview: Dave fights to hang Joe and Beth's strange painting in the lobby; Matthew starts dressing like Lisa.

videos.title: Apartment
videos.overview: Dave and Lisa fight for an apartment, which Max decides he wants; Joe and Beth "fix up" the show's website.

videos.title: Towers
videos.overview: Matthew's 30th birthday causes him to adopt the persona of an 18 year old.  Lisa protests Jimmy's plan to build a 200 story skyscraper.

videos.title: Hair
videos.overview: Jimmy's fear of hippies causes him to blow a big deal; Max and Beth spoil Lisa's dog.

videos.title: Assistant
videos.overview: Lisa's new assistant turns Joe and Dave into rivals; Max complains about the lack of sofa in the men's room.

videos.title: Wino
videos.overview: The formerly evil Johnny Johnson returns to the station, now a homeless wino, to claim Lisa's hand in marriage. Lisa finds it hard to resist Johnny... despite his noxious odor.

videos.title: Wedding
videos.overview: Lisa gets married to Johnny, despite Dave's attempt to talk her out of it.

videos.title: Ploy
videos.overview: Max pretends to quit to hopefully get Beth to beg him to stay. When the ploy fails, Dave has to swallow his pride to get Max back. Lisa's new hyphenated last name, Miller-Johnson, irks both Joe and Matthew.

videos.title: Padded Suit
videos.overview: Dave vents aggression on the staff, threatening to fire someone. Matthew wears a padded suit to learn Joe's karate-like martial art, Joe-jitsu. Mr. James leads a crusade against Mother's Day.

videos.title: Freaky Friday
videos.overview: Jimmy and Matthew switch places for a day, with life altering results.  Dave bans Max from the breakroom.

videos.title: Retirement
videos.overview: Mr. James announces that he's selling the station and retiring to New Hampshire. Dave believes it's a ploy. Lisa organizes a retirement party to convince Mr. James to stay.

videos.title: New Hampshire
videos.overview: Jimmy returns to finalize the sale of the station and tries to persuade one staff member to relocate to New Hampshire with him.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 win & 14 nominations total
